title: Domain Registrations: Domain Care Refund on an Inbound Transfer Charge
content:
**Refunds desk calculation sheet — Domain Registrations**

Under Domain Care, Domain Registrations price-matches only the most recent inbound transfer charge of a domain, and the refund returns that charge's Domain Care credits up to the amount billed.

## 1. The charge

The most recent inbound transfer charge is the inbound transfer charge line of the domain with the latest charge date; a domain is never billed two such charges on one day, and an older inbound transfer charge is never price-matched. The price match is made only on that charge where it was billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025 and paid by card or PayPal; a most recent inbound transfer charge billed on another date, or paid any other way than by card or PayPal, earns no price-match refund. The years the charge covered are the registration years shown on that charge line.

## 2. The amount

The price-match refund is the charge's Domain Care credits, never more than the amount billed on the charge, rounded half up to the cent, and nothing is refunded where those credits come to zero.

The Domain Care credits of an inbound transfer charge are the amounts named as one of the charge's Domain Care credits, added together, each read from the account's records on the day of the price match. Where no Domain Care credit applies to the charge, the credits come to zero and nothing is refunded.

| Domain Care credits of the charge | Price-match refund |
|---|---|
| zero | nothing |
| above zero, not more than the amount billed | the credits, rounded half up to the cent |
| more than the amount billed | the amount billed on the charge |

## 3. Worked figures (hypothetical)

- A charge of USD 36.20 billed on 9 August 2023 by card, credits read on the day of the price match coming to USD 4.15: the refund is USD 4.15.
- The same charge with credits coming to USD 41.00: the refund is limited to USD 36.20.
- A charge billed on 2 March 2021 by card: outside the billing dates, no price-match refund.
- A charge billed on 9 August 2023 from account credit: no price-match refund.
- A charge billed on 9 August 2023 by PayPal on which no Domain Care credit applies: nothing is refunded.
